system.text:
Elven Bladesmiths tend to be very sharp—their attention to detail and ability to reason is renowned even among the Elves. It is said that this ability to see a matter to its conclusion comes from centuries of staring at the tip of the blade. Bladesmiths may round up when factoring the roots for any skill that includes Perception in its root stat

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Elven lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 311
